infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MathHelper uses the camera to scan math problems from books, notebooks, or whiteboards. The photo is analyzed by AI to provide step-by-step solutions.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MathHelper accesses your photo library to upload images of math problems. Images are used only to solve the problem and are never stored on any server.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MathHelper does not use the microphone. This permission is required only by the camera framework.

web.name: MathHelper
web.description: Math problem solver with step-by-step solutions
